# Anthony Pye

## Overview

- **Age:** School-age child (around ten years old in Volume 5)  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v5 c3 P27](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0027)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045)</sub>
- **Role:** School pupil  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P2](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0002)</sub>

## Appearance

Anthony has a dark, sullen little face and black eyes that can sparkle with curiosity or mockery. His hair matches the reddish hue typical of his family's reputation. He is known for an impertinent swagger and a sullen or defiant facial expression.

_Sources: [v1 c9 P30](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0030), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P28](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0028), [v2 c12 P1](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0001), [v2 c12 P28](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0028)_

## Personality

Anthony is an independent, rebellious, and sullen boy who resists authority, particularly from female teachers. He exhibits a mischievous, defiant nature, frequently playing pranks or mocking his instructors. Despite his stubborn and defiant front, he respects strength and fairness, eventually coming to hold Anne Shirley in high regard after she demonstrates firm discipline. He is also quite opinionated and makes up his mind about things on his own.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 c5 P27](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0027), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005), [v2 c12 P28](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0028), [v2 c12 P50](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0050), [v2 c12 P52](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0052)_

## Goals

- To resist the authority of female schoolteachers  <sub>[v2 c5 P27](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0027)</sub>

## History

Anthony Pye was taken in by his uncle and aunt, Mr. and Mrs. George Pye of Avonlea, as an orphan nephew. When Anne Shirley took over the Avonlea school, Anthony was one of her new pupils and immediately displayed a hostile and rebellious attitude, declaring that female teachers were 'no good.' He engaged in persistent minor misconduct, such as pouring water down a classmate's neck and placing a live mouse in Anne's desk to mock her. When confronted, he insolently admitted to the prank, prompting Anne to lose her temper and whip him with a pointer. Following this punishment, Anthony's attitude shifted remarkably; he began showing respect toward Anne, offering to carry her books and acknowledging her capability as a teacher. In later school years, he violently defended Anne's reputation when other boys spoke ill of her.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 c5 P27](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0027), [v2 c12 P24](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0024), [v2 c12 P28](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0028), [v2 c12 P31](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0031), [v2 c12 P49](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0049), [v2 c12 P52](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0052), [v5 c3 P27](../source/v05-c03.md#nw-v05-c03-p0027)_
